jobs.description:
**Overview**
 Are you someone who is passionate, motivated, and driven to make a difference? If so, MSA Safety is the perfect fit for your career.
   

  

 At MSA, SAFETY is who we are AND it is what we do. We are a purpose\-driven company committed to deploying innovation and technology to deliver on our Mission to help protect people and assets all around the world. We continue to be relentless in our pursuit of solving our customers greatest problems so they can go home safe each and every day.
   

  

 Are you in? Read on for more details about this particular role.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own end\-to\-end subscription\-to\-revenue solution architecture: run Fit\-to\-Standard / explore\-phase workshops, drive Key Design Decisions, and produce solution and RICEFW documentation aligned to SAP Activate methodology.
* Configure RAR on S/4HANA — revenue accounting contracts, performance obligations (POBs), BRFplus decision tables, account determination, and posting logic for point\-in\-time and over\-time recognition — as part of the ECC\-to\-S/4HANA conversion.
* Architect the SAP Subscription Billing solution (cloud, on SAP BTP): rate plans and pricing, subscription lifecycle, usage rating/metering, and bill creation for recurring, one\-time, usage/consumption\-based, and tiered models.
* Design the integration between SAP Subscription Billing and S/4HANA \- billing/invoice data flowing into Convergent Invoicing (FI\-CA) and/or SD billing, and onward into RAR — using SAP Integration Suite / API\-based (iFlow) patterns; define the BTP integration and data architecture.
* Lead fit\-gap analysis on complex subscription and revenue scenarios — multi\-element/bundled software\-plus\-service deals, ramp deals, mid\-term upgrades/downgrades and proration, cancellations and credits, usage overages, and contract modifications under ASC 606\.
* Design the inflight\-contract transition and initial\-load strategy; define the migration approach for revenue data moving off ECC, and the onboarding/migration approach for active subscriptions into SAP Subscription Billing.
* Ensure RAR sub\-ledger reconciliation with FI\-GL and COPA, and reconciliation between Subscription Billing, invoicing (CI/FI\-CA), and revenue; validate G/L postings with accounting teams and support disclosure and reporting needs.
* Direct integration, regression, and UAT testing across the S/4HANA and BTP landscape; lead cutover, go\-live, and hypercare, including high\-volume order, subscription, and usage\-data conversion validation.
* Own the solution post\-go\-live: lead support, period\-close and billing\-cycle support, enhancements, and SAP release/upgrade impact assessments (including the cloud release cadence of Subscription Billing), and maintain solution documentation and governance.
* Manage and direct system integrator (SI) resources, coordinate with internal functional/configuration teams, and partner with internal audit, external auditors, and controllership on ongoing compliance and revenue policy changes.


**Qualifications**
* Hands\-on SAP RAR configuration experience across full\-lifecycle implementations and/or ECC\-to\-S/4HANA conversions; relevant SAP certifications (RAR, SD/FI) preferred.
* Experience implementing or integrating SAP Subscription Billing (the standalone cloud product on BTP), including rate plans, usage rating, and the S/4HANA integration pattern; familiarity with Convergent Invoicing (FI\-CA) as the landing point is an asset.
* Deep IFRS 15 / ASC 606 revenue recognition expertise as applied to subscription and multi\-element arrangements, including transition and initial\-load strategies.
* Strong command of BRFplus, ARL, and RAI\-based integration between billing and RAR.
* Working knowledge of SAP BTP and SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration / iFlows, APIs) for cloud\-to\-S/4HANA integration.
* Proven OTC/QTC and order/subscription\-management architecture experience (pricing, account determination, Fiori) feeding billing and revenue.
* Preferred experience with SAP ECC to S/4 HANA migration or full life cycle S/4 HANA Implementation and support.
* Fluency in SAP Activate deliverables by phase and in cutover discipline (freeze windows, mock cycles, reconciliation gates, go/no\-go).
* RAR / event\-based revenue recognition exposure for subscriptions.
* Familiarity with S/4HANA Private Cloud (RISE) deployment and SAP Activate; FI\-GL and COPA integration knowledge.
* Demonstrated ability to lead internal teams and SI partners, and to bridge technical and accounting/business audiences.


**Education and experience required:**
 This position is available at three different career levels based upon experience:
   

  

* Level I: 2 years IT or related business process experience
* Level II: 3 years IT or related business process experience and 2 years SAP configuration experience in the SD modules
* Level III: 5 years IT or related Sales and Distribution business process experience and 5 years SAP configuration experience in SD modules


**Preferred:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Information Science, Computer Science, or related discipline.

**Who We Are**  

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. **Job Description**  

HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build **HPE Networking**, with the ambition of creating the **best networking business on the planet**. This role sits at the center of that effort as part of **the Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) program**, responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a **single platform**, replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.


As part of a fast\-moving, **multi\-year transformation**, the team will stabilize near\-term operations, **migrate core** **platforms, onboard****businesses****and suppliers globally**, and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with**business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders** on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.


For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help**build a new business unit from its earliest days**, rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain **hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership**, with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. If you want your work to have a visible impact on a company making a significant investment in its future, this is where that happens.

**Workstream\-Specific Details**

**Responsibilities**

* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of the SAP BRIM workstream (Subscription Order Management, Convergent Charging, Convergent Invoicing, and FI\-CA) within the L2C program, from requirements through design, build, test, cutover, and HyperCare.
* Own the integrated project plan, milestones, critical path, and RACI, and keep delivery aligned to the broader L2C roadmap and dependent workstreams.
* Manage a cross\-functional delivery team spanning HPE business and IT stakeholders, system integrator partners, and onshore/offshore development and testing resources.
* Manage scope, schedule, budget, and resourcing, including forecast versus actuals, change control, and clear trade\-off recommendations when priorities shift.
* Own RAID management — proactively surface risks, issues, assumptions, and cross\-workstream dependencies, and drive them to closure with the right level of escalation.
* Coordinate integration design and delivery across SAP S/4HANA, CPQ, CRM, entitlement and fulfillment platforms, and the data migration streams supporting the combined HPE and Juniper portfolios.
* Drive test strategy and execution across SIT, UAT, and performance testing, and govern defect triage and resolution to exit criteria.
* Plan and execute cutover, go\-live, and HyperCare, including business readiness, training coordination, and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Provide clear, executive\-ready status reporting and represent the workstream in program governance and steering committee forums.
* Ensure delivery meets applicable audit, SOX, security, and data privacy control requirements.
**Education And Experience Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related field; advanced degree an asset.
* 10\+ years of IT project and program management experience delivering large\-scale enterprise applications, with at least 5 years in the SAP ecosystem.
* 3\+ full\-lifecycle SAP BRIM / Hybris Billing implementations in a project or workstream lead capacity, including at least one global rollout.
* Demonstrated experience delivering subscription, consumption, or as\-a\-service monetization capabilities in a quote\-to\-cash or lead\-to\-cash context.
* Experience managing blended onshore/offshore delivery teams and system integrator partners against fixed milestones and budgets.
* Experience delivering within a large\-scale business transformation, ERP migration, or post\-merger integration program is strongly preferred.
* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or Scrum certification preferred.
